name: Safe Shutdown
creator: badamsz
desc: Gracefully shut down the connected computer, the NanoKVM Go itself, or both - and confirm the computer powered off.

TARGET_OS.label: Target OS profile
TARGET_OS.description: windows, windows-dialog, linux-power-key, linux-terminal, macos, or custom.

CUSTOM_SEQUENCE.label: Custom key sequence
CUSTOM_SEQUENCE.description: Used when TARGET_OS is custom. Steps separated by ';' - key:MetaLeft+KeyR, key:Power@200, text:shutdown /s /t 0, wait:1500. Use \; for a literal semicolon.

VERIFY_TIMEOUT.label: Power-off timeout (seconds)
VERIFY_TIMEOUT.description: How long to wait for the target's video signal to disappear before reporting it is still on.

NANOKVM_MCP_KEY.label: MCP API key (optional)
NANOKVM_MCP_KEY.description: Leave empty to read the key from /etc/kvm/ai.json. MCP must be enabled in the NanoKVM web UI either way.
